dek: The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in London (London ETO) has supported three Hong Kong performance programmes at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe 2026, showcasing Hong Kong's vibrant arts and cultural scene to international audiences through a cappella theatre, Cantonese opera and contemporary dance.
